thread:
Jules (CSM): Flagging Lumenix — sudden seat freeze after their org admin revoked API access during an internal audit. MAU down ~68% over 48h. Renewal in 3.5 weeks. Need triage and procurement playbook.

watcher-bot: Auto-alert: Lumenix: active_seats: 410 -> 132 (-67.8%), auth.errors: api.access_revoked (4,120). dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/lumenix/health

Cal (AE): Procurement now talking to OrionAI — they ran a month-long pilot and pitched a migration discount. Lumenix asked for a migration estimate. We should buy time and show value quickly.

Rina (Customer Ops): New procurement lead is S. Morozova (started this week). Old champion (Head of ML) left. I'll intro Jules to Morozova and request an urgent admin call.

Vik (Solutions Eng): Likely safe to re-provision new service tokens and audit who revoked access. Quick ops command for admins (internal only):
```
# reissue short-lived org admin token (48h)
redwoodctl keys create --org lumenix --scope admin --expires 48h --reason "audit-unblock"
```
I'll also gather recent token-revoke audit logs and a short remediation checklist.

Jules (CSM): Proposed play: 1) immediate admin screen-share to reprovision tokens and validate RBAC; 2) offer a 10-day onboarding concierge (CS+SE) to finish migration checks; 3) prepare a neutral competitive comparison vs OrionAI for S. Morozova. Legal to review offer language.

Avery (Legal): We can approve a non-binding concierge offer. Do not state "trial" or commit Dedicated capacity or discounts without Legal+Finance sign-off. Send copy before outreach.

billing-bot: Note: Temporary admin keys and concierge hours are billable at regular rates. If you want to provide credits, open a billing-exceptions ticket.

Cal (AE): I'll hold off on any migration pricing discussions until we stabilize usage. Will prep a short value checklist vs OrionAI emphasizing integrations and migration cost.

Rina (Customer Ops): Scheduling admin screen-share tomorrow 09:00 PT with S. Morozova and their security lead. Jules/CAL/Vik, can you join?

Jules (CSM): Yes, will join. Vik please bring the audit logs and a one-page RBAC checklist. Action items: Rina schedule call; Vik prep logs + checklist; Cal draft competitor bullets; Avery review outreach copy. watcher-bot will monitor and alert if active_seats doesn't recover to >60% baseline within 12h. :eyes:
